newsitem.title: USA: FM Properties says ups ownership threshold.
newsitem.headline: FM Properties says ups ownership threshold.

text.p: FM Properties Inc said Monday it increased the percentage ownership threshold at which its stockholder rights plan is activated.
The company said the rights can now be exercised whenever an individual or group purchases 20 percent or more of its common stock.

The company said that if a stockholder exceeds the 20 percent threshold, all other stockholders will be able to exercise their rights, which will entitle them to buy common stock at a discounted price.
The company said that previously, the rights issued under the plan could have been exercised whenever a group or individual purchased 15 percent of the stock.
The company said the change in response to a request from a large stockholder to allow it to increase its holdings above the current 15 percent level.
